A farmstead in south-eastern [[Arathi Highlands]], near [[Witherbark Village]].

==Hints of a New Plague==
This once-human farmstead was occupied by Orcs and Forsaken from [[Hammerfall]] some time after Third War. Since then, the Forsaken have been using this village as test ground for their mysterious alchemical experiments.

Two agents of Alliance, [[Quae]] and [[Kinelory]], were sent to investigate this issue and with help of some adventurers have first stopped a [[Forsaken]] courier travelling to [[Tarren Mill]], and then discovered within the village notes and research of [[Apothecary Jorell]]. It seems the apothecary was working on some new kind of Plague.
